title: 吉隆坡雙子星塔~Petronas Twin Towers
focus: 高強度混凝土管中管、可隨兩塔移動的雙鉸拱空橋，以及喀斯特地質上的深樁筏基~A high-strength concrete tube-in-tube, a two-hinged arch skybridge that moves with both towers, and deep piles and rafts on karstic ground
summary: 從核心筒與周邊柱環的側力分工、以混凝土重量換取低加速度出發，計算高強度混凝土圓柱的容量與空橋支腳的轉角，再處理避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基、兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制、高強度混凝土驗收與雙塔風洞干擾，最後是熱帶氣候下的外牆維護與空橋作為避難路徑的交接。~Starting from lateral load sharing between the core and the perimeter column ring and from trading concrete weight for low acceleration, compute the capacity of high-strength concrete columns and the rotation of the skybridge legs, then handle the site shift away from a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts, geometry control with two contractors working in parallel, high-strength concrete acceptance and twin-tower wind interference, ending with façade upkeep in a tropical climate and the handover of the skybridge as an escape route.

units.anchor: 核心筒與周邊柱環~Core and perimeter column ring
units.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工~Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube
units.mechanism: 雙子星塔每座塔以約 23 m × 23 m 的鋼筋混凝土核心筒，加上一圈間距較大的圓形超級柱組成「管中管」系統，周邊柱以環梁連成框架筒，兩者經樓板共同抵抗側力。核心筒提供大部分剪力勁度，周邊框架筒則以較大的力臂提供抗傾覆能力；框架筒的效率取決於環梁勁度，環梁越柔，翼面柱子的軸力越受剪力滯後影響而無法充分發揮。選擇混凝土而非鋼構，部分原因是當時鋼材需進口、成本高，而高強度混凝土是在地承包商熟悉的材料。~Each Petronas tower combines a reinforced concrete core of about 23 m × 23 m with a ring of widely spaced circular super columns in a tube-in-tube system; ring beams link the perimeter columns into a framed tube, and floors make the two work together against lateral load. The core supplies most of the shear stiffness while the perimeter tube, with its larger lever arm, supplies overturning resistance; the tube's efficiency depends on ring-beam stiffness, because flexible ring beams let shear lag keep flange columns from developing their full axial share. Concrete rather than steel was chosen partly because steel then had to be imported at high cost, while high-strength concrete was familiar to local contractors.
units.model: 有效慣性矩比較：核心 23 m 見方、牆厚 0.75 m，I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴；16 支直徑 2.4 m 圓柱位於半徑 22 m 圓周，完全共同作用時 I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴，若環梁柔度使效率 η = 0.3，有效 I ≈ 5,250 m⁴，周邊分擔約 49%；η = 0.5 時約 61%。柱數與尺寸為教學假設。~Effective inertia comparison: a 23 m square core with 0.75 m walls has I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴; 16 columns of 2.4 m diameter on a 22 m radius would give I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴ if fully composite, but with ring-beam flexibility limiting efficiency to η = 0.3 the effective I is about 5,250 m⁴ and the perimeter share about 49%, rising to about 61% at η = 0.5. Column count and size are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。~Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements.
units.failure: 若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。~If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action.
units.misconception: 管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。~In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
units.practice: 環梁的開孔、續接與配筋列為結構關鍵項目，機電穿孔必須在設計階段定位並補強，施工中任何新增開孔都需結構工程師書面同意。~Treat ring-beam openings, splices and reinforcement as critical structural items; locate and reinforce service penetrations at the design stage, and require the structural engineer's written approval for any new opening during construction.

units.anchor: 混凝土質量與風振~Concrete mass and wind sway
units.title: 以重量換取低加速度~Trading weight for low acceleration
units.mechanism: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。對風致振動而言，加速度與參與振動的質量成反比，而混凝土結構的固有阻尼通常也比鋼構略高，兩者都讓居住者感受到的晃動減少。代價是基礎必須承受更大的重力，地震時的慣性力也隨質量增加，因此重量帶來的好處只在風控制設計時成立。~Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. For wind-induced vibration, acceleration is inversely proportional to the participating mass, and concrete structures usually have slightly higher inherent damping than steel, both reducing the motion occupants feel. The price is heavier gravity loads on the foundations and larger inertia forces in earthquakes, so the benefit of weight holds only where wind governs the design.
units.model: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。鋼構方案 M = 200,000 t、ζ = 1.5%，混凝土方案 M = 300,000 t、ζ = 2%：加速度比 = (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58，即混凝土塔的加速度約為鋼構塔的 58%（未計週期差異）。數值為教學假設。~Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). For a steel scheme with M = 200,000 t and ζ = 1.5% versus a concrete scheme with M = 300,000 t and ζ = 2%, the acceleration ratio is (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58, so the concrete tower sees about 58% of the steel tower's acceleration, ignoring period differences. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。~Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic.
units.failure: 若設計時把混凝土阻尼取得過高，而完工實測阻尼較低，強風時加速度可能超出舒適度門檻；增加的質量若未在基礎與地震分析中完整計入，會低估樁的承載需求與地震力。~If concrete damping is assumed too high in design and the measured value proves lower, accelerations can exceed comfort limits in strong winds; if the added mass is not fully carried into the foundation and seismic analyses, pile demands and earthquake forces are underestimated.
units.misconception: 建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。~The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
units.practice: 結構方案比選時，應同時列出重量、基礎需求、風致加速度與地震力四項，讓業主看清取捨；阻尼假設要引用實測資料或文獻範圍，並在交接時提供實測值。~When comparing structural schemes, tabulate weight, foundation demand, wind acceleration and seismic force together so the owner sees the trade-offs; base damping assumptions on measured data or published ranges, and hand over the measured values at completion.

units.anchor: 高強度混凝土圓柱~High-strength concrete circular columns
units.title: 高強度混凝土圓柱的軸壓容量~Axial capacity of high-strength concrete columns
units.mechanism: 雙子星塔的周邊超級柱為圓形鋼筋混凝土柱，隨高度逐段縮小，以高強度混凝土承受每座塔約 300,000 公噸重量中的大部分。高強度混凝土讓柱斷面變小、可用樓地板增加，但材料較脆，需要較密的箍筋或螺旋筋提供圍束，才能在地震或意外超載時保有延性；其彈性模數、徐變與乾縮也與一般混凝土不同，影響柱與核心之間的差異縮短。~The Petronas perimeter super columns are circular reinforced concrete columns that step down in size with height, using high-strength concrete to carry most of each tower's roughly 300,000 t weight. High-strength concrete shrinks column sections and frees floor area, but it is more brittle and needs closely spaced ties or spirals for confinement to keep ductility in an earthquake or accidental overload; its elastic modulus, creep and shrinkage also differ from ordinary concrete, affecting differential shortening between columns and core.
units.model: P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st。直徑 2.4 m：A_g ≈ 4.52 m²、ρ = 2% 時 A_st ≈ 0.090 m²；f'c = 80 MPa、f_y = 420 MPa，P₀ ≈ 301.5 + 38.0 ≈ 339.5 MN，最大設計軸力 0.80×0.65×P₀ ≈ 176.5 MN。若 f'c 只有 40 MPa，約 98.1 MN，柱數或斷面須增加約八成。數值為教學假設。~P₀ = 0.85·f'c·(A_g − A_st) + f_y·A_st. For a 2.4 m diameter, A_g ≈ 4.52 m² and A_st ≈ 0.090 m² at ρ = 2%; with f'c = 80 MPa and f_y = 420 MPa, P₀ ≈ 301.5 + 38.0 ≈ 339.5 MN and the maximum design axial force is 0.80×0.65×P₀ ≈ 176.5 MN. With f'c of only 40 MPa it is about 98.1 MN, so columns or sections must grow by about 80%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以試拌確認高強度混凝土的強度、彈性模數與工作性，施工中依批次取試體；柱的螺旋筋間距與保護層以現場量測抽查，並在澆置前檢查鋼筋籠是否留有足夠的混凝土通道，避免低坍度的高強度混凝土無法填實。~Confirm strength, elastic modulus and workability of the high-strength mix in trial batches and sample by batch during construction; spot-check spiral pitch and cover on site, and check before each pour that the cage leaves enough passage for the concrete so a stiff high-strength mix can still compact fully.
units.failure: 箍筋或螺旋筋不足時，高強度混凝土柱在接近極限時會突然爆裂、延性很低；若用錯配比（低強度混凝土誤用於高強度柱），柱容量不足，只能拆除重做或以外包鋼板補強，對工期影響極大。~With too few ties or spirals, a high-strength concrete column bursts suddenly near its ultimate load with little ductility; if the wrong, lower-strength mix is placed in a high-strength column, capacity is short and the only remedies are demolition and recasting or steel jacketing, with severe schedule impact.
units.misconception: 高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。~High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
units.practice: 混凝土供應要有「配比－車號－澆置位置」的追蹤紀錄，高強度柱澆置前由監造確認送貨單上的配比編號；任何強度未達標的批次立即標示位置，並通知結構設計者評估。~Keep a mix–truck–location trace for every concrete delivery, with the resident engineer confirming the mix number on the delivery ticket before any high-strength column pour; mark the location of any batch that misses strength immediately and notify the structural designer for assessment.

units.anchor: 空橋雙鉸拱支腳~Skybridge two-hinged arch legs
units.title: 可隨兩塔移動的空橋~A skybridge that moves with two towers
units.mechanism: 兩座塔在第 41 與 42 層以兩層高的空橋相連，跨度約 58.4 m、離地約 170 m、重約 750 公噸。兩座塔在風中各自擺動，空橋若剛接在兩塔上就會被拉扯或擠壓；因此空橋由一對約 51 m 長的鋼管斜腳組成雙鉸拱，腳的下端以可轉動的支承固定在兩塔第 29 層，上端支承空橋，讓兩塔可以獨立移動。空橋端部與塔體之間也須留有滑動與轉動的空間。~The towers are linked at levels 41 and 42 by a two-storey skybridge spanning about 58.4 m, about 170 m above ground and weighing about 750 t. Each tower sways independently in wind, so a skybridge rigidly fixed to both would be pulled and squeezed; instead it is carried by a pair of steel tube legs about 51 m long forming a two-hinged arch, seated on rotating bearings at level 29 of each tower and supporting the bridge at the top, so the towers can move independently. The bridge ends must also leave room for sliding and rotation against the towers.
units.model: 支腳轉角 θ = Δ/L。若兩塔在空橋高度各向相反方向移動 0.3 m，相對位移 0.6 m；長 51 m 的支腳下端支承須容許 θ ≈ 0.3/51 ≈ 0.0059 rad（約 0.34°），空橋端部伸縮裝置則須容許約 ±0.6 m 的相對變位。數值為教學假設。~Leg rotation θ = Δ/L. If the towers move 0.3 m in opposite directions at bridge level, the relative movement is 0.6 m; each 51 m leg's bearing must accept θ ≈ 0.3/51 ≈ 0.0059 rad (about 0.34°), and the bridge-end joints must accommodate about ±0.6 m of relative movement. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以兩塔的風洞與地震分析結果組合出空橋高度的相對位移包絡，確認支承轉角、伸縮裝置行程與淨空都有餘裕；支承出廠前做轉動與承載試驗，安裝後記錄初始位置作為日後比對基準。~Combine wind-tunnel and seismic results for both towers into an envelope of relative movement at bridge level, confirming margin in bearing rotation, joint travel and clearances; test bearings for rotation and load before delivery and record their initial positions after installation as a baseline.
units.failure: 若支承轉動受阻或伸縮裝置行程不足，兩塔反向擺動時空橋與支腳會承受巨大的附加力，可能損壞支承或拉裂塔體的埋件；若空橋被設計成兩塔間的剛性連桿，也會改變兩塔的動力特性。~If bearings bind or joint travel is insufficient, out-of-phase tower sway imposes large extra forces on the bridge and legs, damaging bearings or tearing embeds out of the towers; designing the bridge as a rigid link between the towers would also alter their dynamic behaviour.
units.misconception: 空橋把兩座塔連在一起，可以讓兩塔互相支撐、減少擺動。~The skybridge ties the two towers together so they brace each other and sway less.
units.practice: 空橋支承與伸縮裝置列入定期檢查清單，記錄每次強風或地震後的位移指示；任何在空橋端部增設的管線、裝修或招牌都必須保留可動空間，並經結構工程師核可。~Put skybridge bearings and expansion joints on the periodic inspection list, recording movement indicators after every strong wind or earthquake; any services, finishes or signs added at the bridge ends must preserve the movement gaps and be approved by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 深樁與 4.6 m 筏基~Deep piles and the 4.6 m raft
units.title: 避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基~Shifting the towers off a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts
units.mechanism: 原定基地的鑽探顯示一半位於風化石灰岩、一半位於軟岩，地下岩面有如懸崖，若照原位置興建，兩側沉陷會明顯不同。設計團隊因此把塔位移動約 61 m，讓兩座塔完全坐落在軟岩上；每座塔以 104 支深 60 至 114 m 的混凝土樁支承，上方為厚約 4.6 m 的筏基，混凝土約 13,200 m³，連續澆置約 54 小時完成。樁長不同是為了配合岩面起伏，使各處沉陷趨於一致。~Borings at the original site showed one half on weathered limestone and the other on soft rock, with the rock surface dropping like a cliff, so building in place would have produced markedly different settlement on the two sides. The design team moved the towers about 61 m so both sit entirely on soft rock; each tower rests on 104 concrete piles 60 to 114 m deep beneath a raft about 4.6 m thick, about 13,200 m³ of concrete placed continuously in about 54 hours. The varying pile lengths follow the undulating rock to even out settlement.
units.model: 差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。若一側比另一側多沉陷 30 mm、塔寬約 46 m，θ = 30/46,000 ≈ 1/1,533；在 452 m 高的塔頂造成約 452×(30/46,000) ≈ 0.29 m 的水平偏移，並在柱與核心之間引起附加內力。數值為教學假設。~Tilt from differential settlement θ = Δs/B. If one side settles 30 mm more than the other across a tower about 46 m wide, θ = 30/46,000 ≈ 1/1,533, giving about 452×(30/46,000) ≈ 0.29 m of horizontal offset at the 452 m top, plus extra forces between columns and core. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以密集鑽探與地球物理探測繪出岩面與溶蝕帶分布，依此決定每支樁的長度；施工時記錄每支樁的實際入岩深度與澆置量，並以載重試驗確認摩擦樁承載；完工後持續監測筏基各角落的沉陷並與預測比對。~Map the rock surface and solution zones with dense borings and geophysics to set each pile's length; during construction record each pile's actual rock penetration and concrete volume and confirm friction-pile capacity by load tests; after completion keep monitoring settlement at the raft corners against predictions.
units.failure: 喀斯特石灰岩中的溶洞若未被探測到，樁底可能落在空洞上方，承載與沉陷都無法預測；筏基若因供料中斷形成冷縫，承受巨大集中力的厚板可能在接縫處剪壞或滲水。~Undetected cavities in karstic limestone can leave pile toes above voids, making capacity and settlement unpredictable; a cold joint caused by supply interruption in the raft can let a thick slab carrying huge concentrated loads fail in shear or leak at the joint.
units.misconception: 只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。~If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
units.practice: 基礎設計前的地質調查要涵蓋整個塔位並延伸到可能的移位範圍，發現溶蝕或岩面陡變時，由大地顧問、結構設計者與業主共同決定是否調整塔位；筏基澆置須有不中斷供料的備援計畫。~Site investigation before foundation design must cover the whole footprint and any possible shifted position; when solution features or steep rock surfaces are found, the geotechnical consultant, structural designer and owner decide together whether to move the tower, and the raft pour needs a backup plan for uninterrupted supply.

units.anchor: 雙承包商與垂直度~Two contractors and verticality
units.title: 兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制~Geometry control with two contractors building side by side
units.mechanism: 政府要求六年內完工，兩座塔因此分別由兩個承包團隊施工：塔一由間組領銜，塔二由三星物產領銜。兩塔的施工方法、測量團隊與進度各自獨立，但最後必須以同一座空橋準確相接，對兩塔在第 29 層與第 41、42 層的座標與高程要求一致。公開報導指出塔一施工到約 72 層時曾量得約 25 mm 的垂直偏差，之後以逐層微調修正；這類偏差若累積到空橋層，就會影響空橋支承的就位。~The government required completion within six years, so the two towers were built by separate teams: Tower 1 led by Hazama and Tower 2 led by Samsung C&T. Their methods, survey teams and schedules ran independently, yet they had to meet a single skybridge precisely, demanding consistent coordinates and levels on both towers at level 29 and at levels 41 and 42. Public reports say Tower 1 was found about 25 mm out of plumb at around level 72 and corrected by small adjustments floor by floor; deviations of this kind accumulating at bridge level would disturb the seating of the bridge supports.
units.model: 偏差修正率：若在約 72 層發現 25 mm 偏差，打算在其上 16 層內修正，每層平均修正 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm；以約 300 m 高度計，25 mm 的傾角約 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000。修正量要小到不影響樓板與帷幕的接合。數值為教學假設。~Correction rate: if a 25 mm deviation found at about level 72 is to be removed over the next 16 floors, the average correction is 25/16 ≈ 1.6 mm per floor; at a height of about 300 m, 25 mm corresponds to a tilt of about 25/300,000 ≈ 1/12,000. Corrections must stay small enough not to upset slab and façade connections. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 兩塔共用同一套控制網與基準點，由獨立測量單位定期聯測兩塔關鍵樓層的座標與高程；空橋支承層施工前做一次聯合檢核，確認兩塔的相對位置符合空橋製造尺寸，否則先調整支承墊板設計。~Run both towers from one control network and set of datums, with an independent survey team periodically tying in coordinates and levels on key floors of both; before the skybridge support levels are built, hold a joint check confirming that the towers' relative positions match the bridge's fabricated dimensions, otherwise redesign the bearing packs first.
units.failure: 兩塔若各自使用不同的基準或座標轉換，誤差要到空橋吊裝時才被發現，只能在高空臨時修改支承或切割構件；逐層修正若過於急促，樓板邊緣與帷幕單元會出現階差。~If each tower uses its own datum or coordinate transformation, the mismatch surfaces only when the skybridge is lifted, forcing makeshift changes to supports or cutting of members at height; corrections made too abruptly leave steps at slab edges and curtain-wall units.
units.misconception: 兩座塔各自做到垂直，空橋自然就能對準。~If each tower is built plumb on its own, the skybridge will automatically fit.
units.practice: 合約要明訂共同控制網、聯測頻率與容許偏差，關鍵樓層設置聯合簽認的停止點；任何修正計畫由兩塔的結構與測量負責人共同核可，並通知空橋製造商。~Contracts should specify a shared control network, tie-in frequency and tolerances, with jointly signed hold points at key floors; any correction plan is approved by the structural and survey leads of both towers and notified to the skybridge fabricator.

units.anchor: 混凝土強度驗收~Concrete strength acceptance
units.title: 高強度混凝土的驗收與不合格處理~Acceptance of high-strength concrete and handling non-conformance
units.mechanism: 以高強度混凝土為主要材料的超高層，整棟樓的安全建立在每一車混凝土的品質上。驗收依統計原則：單一試體偶有偏低是正常變異，但連續數組的平均值不足或單組過低，就代表供料或施工有系統性問題。不合格時的處理順序是先確認試體本身是否有問題，再以鑽心取樣評估結構內的實際強度，最後才由設計者判斷補強或拆除。~In a supertall tower built mainly of high-strength concrete, the safety of the whole building rests on the quality of every truckload. Acceptance follows statistical rules: an occasional low specimen is normal variation, but a low running average or a single very low set signals a systematic problem in supply or placement. When results fail, the order is to check the specimens themselves first, then assess in-place strength by coring, and only then have the designer decide between strengthening and demolition.
units.model: ACI 318 對 f'c > 35 MPa 的準則：連續三組平均 ≥ f'c，且單組 ≥ 0.90f'c。f'c = 80 MPa 時，84、78、79 MPa 的平均 80.3 MPa、最低 78 ≥ 72，合格；82、74、76 MPa 的平均 77.3 MPa 不合格，須鑽心評估（三個鑽心平均 ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa 且單一 ≥ 0.75f'c = 60 MPa）。試驗數值為教學假設。~Using the ACI 318 criteria for f'c above 35 MPa, every average of three consecutive tests must be ≥ f'c and no single test below 0.90f'c. With f'c = 80 MPa, tests of 84, 78 and 79 MPa average 80.3 MPa with a minimum of 78 ≥ 72 and pass; 82, 74 and 76 MPa average 77.3 MPa and fail, requiring cores (three cores averaging ≥ 0.85f'c = 68 MPa with none below 0.75f'c = 60 MPa). Test values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 建立試體取樣、養護與試驗的追溯流程，每組試體對應澆置位置；不合格時先檢查試體養護與試驗紀錄，再於該位置鑽心並輔以非破壞檢測，結果送設計者評估，必要時以載重試驗確認。~Set up a traceable sampling, curing and testing procedure with every set linked to its placement location; on failure check specimen curing and test records first, then core the location with supporting non-destructive tests and send the results to the designer, confirming by load testing where needed.
units.failure: 若驗收只看單組結果而忽略連續平均，供料品質的緩慢下滑可能到多層樓完成後才被發現；不合格樓板或柱若未及時處理，上方繼續施工會增加荷重，使補救更困難，最後只能拆除重做。~Judging only single results and ignoring running averages can hide a slow decline in supply quality until many floors are complete; if non-conforming slabs or columns are not dealt with promptly, work above adds load and makes repair harder, until demolition and recasting are the only option.
units.misconception: 只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。~If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
units.practice: 品質計畫要訂出「試體不合格即停止在其上方施工」的停止點，直到設計者完成評估；配比、供料廠與試驗室資料按日彙整，趨勢下滑時提前介入。~The quality plan sets a hold point that stops work above any failing location until the designer completes the assessment; compile mix, plant and laboratory data daily and intervene early when trends slip.

units.anchor: 兩塔相對位移的統計組合~Statistical combination of relative movement
units.title: 風洞試驗與雙塔干擾效應~Wind-tunnel testing and twin-tower interference
units.mechanism: 兩座相同的塔並列時，風經過上游塔產生的尾流會衝擊下游塔，造成比單塔更大的擾動，稱為干擾效應；同時空橋要承受的不是單塔位移，而是兩塔在同一時刻的相對位移。兩塔的運動部分相關、部分獨立：完全同步時相對位移為零，完全反向時最大。風洞試驗必須同時放置兩座塔的模型，量測各風向下兩塔的位移時程，再以統計方法求出相對位移的設計值。~When two identical towers stand side by side, the wake from the upwind tower buffets the downwind one, causing more disturbance than for a single tower, known as interference; meanwhile the skybridge must accept not single-tower movement but the two towers' simultaneous relative movement. Their motions are partly correlated and partly independent: in perfect step the relative movement is zero, in exact opposition it is greatest. The wind tunnel must model both towers together, record their displacement histories for each wind direction and derive the design relative movement statistically.
units.model: 相對位移標準差 σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂)。σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m：相關係數 ρ = 0.3 時 σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m，乘以尖峰因子 3.5 得約 0.62 m；ρ = 0 時約 0.74 m；完全反向 ρ = −1 時約 1.05 m。數值為教學假設。~Relative-displacement standard deviation σ_rel = √(σ₁² + σ₂² − 2ρσ₁σ₂). With σ₁ = σ₂ = 0.15 m, a correlation ρ = 0.3 gives σ_rel ≈ 0.177 m and, with a peak factor of 3.5, about 0.62 m; ρ = 0 gives about 0.74 m and fully opposed motion, ρ = −1, about 1.05 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 雙塔模型同時裝設位移或加速度量測，取得同步時程並計算各風向的相關係數；設計值取最不利風向的相對位移，並與單塔結果直接相加的保守估算比較，確認空橋支承與伸縮裝置的行程足夠。~Instrument both models simultaneously for displacement or acceleration, obtain synchronised histories and compute the correlation for each wind direction; take the design value from the worst direction's relative movement, compare it with the conservative estimate of simply adding single-tower results, and confirm the skybridge bearings and joints have enough travel.
units.failure: 若只用單塔風洞資料，下游塔受尾流衝擊的放大與兩塔反向擺動的機率都會被忽略，空橋端部的伸縮裝置可能在強風時碰到行程極限，損壞裝置並讓空橋承受衝擊力。~Using single-tower data alone ignores the amplification on the downwind tower from wake buffeting and the chance of opposed sway, so bridge-end joints can hit their travel limits in strong winds, damaging the joints and subjecting the bridge to impact.
units.misconception: 兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。~Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
units.practice: 風洞試驗範圍要明列雙塔干擾與相對位移的輸出項目；完工後在兩塔空橋層附近設置同步加速度計，強風事件後比對實測相對位移與設計值，偏差大時通知結構顧問。~Make twin-tower interference and relative movement explicit deliverables of the wind-tunnel scope; after completion fit synchronised accelerometers near bridge level in both towers and compare measured relative movement with the design value after strong-wind events, notifying the structural consultant of large deviations.

units.anchor: 不鏽鋼與玻璃外牆~Stainless-steel and glass façade
units.title: 熱帶氣候下的外牆熱脹與維護~Thermal movement and upkeep of the façade in a tropical climate
units.mechanism: 雙子星塔的外牆以不鏽鋼與玻璃為主，在吉隆坡終年高溫、強烈日照與熱帶暴雨下運作。不鏽鋼的熱膨脹係數比玻璃與混凝土大，日照時外露金屬升溫快，三種材料的伸縮差會集中在接縫、密封膠與固定件上；暴雨與高濕度則考驗排水與防水設計。外牆的長期維護包括密封膠更換、固定件腐蝕檢查與玻璃破損更換，都需要能到達每一處的外牆維護設備。~The Petronas façade is mainly stainless steel and glass, working year-round in Kuala Lumpur's heat, strong sun and tropical downpours. Stainless steel expands more with heat than glass or concrete, and exposed metal heats quickly in sunshine, so the differential movement of the three materials concentrates at joints, sealants and fixings, while heavy rain and humidity test drainage and waterproofing. Long-term upkeep includes sealant replacement, fixing corrosion checks and broken-glass replacement, all requiring access equipment that can reach every part of the façade.
units.model: 熱脹 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。4 m 長的構件、溫升 50 °C：沃斯田鐵系不鏽鋼 α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm；玻璃 α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C，ΔL = 1.8 mm；兩者相差 1.6 mm，須由接縫與密封膠吸收。數值為教學假設。~Thermal expansion ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a 4 m member heating by 50 °C, austenitic stainless steel with α = 17×10⁻⁶ /°C grows ΔL = 17×10⁻⁶×4,000×50 = 3.4 mm, while glass with α = 9×10⁻⁶ /°C grows 1.8 mm; the 1.6 mm difference must be taken up by joints and sealant. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以實尺寸試體做熱循環、水密與氣密試驗，確認接縫在反覆伸縮下不漏水；營運中定期檢查密封膠的硬化與龜裂、不鏽鋼與碳鋼固定件接觸處的電位腐蝕，以及排水孔是否阻塞。~Test full-scale specimens under thermal cycling, water and air tightness to confirm joints stay watertight through repeated movement; in service inspect regularly for sealant hardening and cracking, galvanic corrosion where stainless steel contacts carbon-steel fixings, and blocked drainage holes.
units.failure: 若接縫寬度只按玻璃的熱脹設計，不鏽鋼伸長會擠壓密封膠並造成脫膠，雨水滲入後腐蝕固定件；不同金屬直接接觸而未絕緣，在潮濕環境下的電位腐蝕會削弱固定件。~Sizing joints only for glass expansion lets the stainless steel squeeze and debond the sealant, admitting rain that corrodes the fixings; dissimilar metals in direct contact without isolation suffer galvanic corrosion in the humid climate, weakening the fixings.
units.misconception: 不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。~Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
units.practice: 交接文件列出外牆材料的熱脹設計值、接縫容許變形、密封膠更換週期與異種金屬絕緣細部；維護紀錄依立面與樓層編號管理，方便追蹤重複發生的漏水點。~Handover documents list the design thermal movements of façade materials, allowable joint deformation, sealant replacement intervals and dissimilar-metal isolation details; organise maintenance records by elevation and floor to track recurring leaks.

units.anchor: 空橋避難路徑~Skybridge escape route
units.title: 空橋作為避難路徑的長期維護與交接~Lifecycle upkeep of the skybridge as an escape route
units.mechanism: 雙子星塔的空橋不只是觀光設施，也是火災避難策略的一部分：一座塔發生緊急狀況時，上層人員可經空橋疏散到另一座塔，再由另一座塔的樓梯或電梯離開。這使空橋的結構、支承、防火與通道淨寬都成為生命安全系統，必須在整個建築壽命中保持可用。任何改裝（例如增設展示、管線或改變出入口）都要確認不會縮減淨寬、阻礙門扇或侵入空橋的可動空間。~The Petronas skybridge is not just an attraction but part of the fire-evacuation strategy: in an emergency in one tower, occupants of the upper floors can cross to the other tower and leave by its stairs or lifts. That makes the bridge's structure, bearings, fire protection and clear width parts of a life-safety system that must remain available throughout the building's life. Any alteration, such as added displays, services or changed entrances, must be checked so it does not reduce clear width, obstruct doors or encroach on the bridge's movement gaps.
units.model: 通行能力 = 淨寬 × 單位流率。淨寬 2.4 m、流率 1.3 人/(m·s) 時約 3.1 人/秒；若需疏散 10,000 人，約需 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s，約 53 分鐘。淨寬若因改裝減為 1.8 m，時間增為約 71 分鐘。數值為教學假設。~Capacity = clear width × unit flow rate. A 2.4 m clear width at 1.3 persons per metre per second passes about 3.1 persons per second, so evacuating 10,000 people takes about 10,000/3.12 ≈ 3,205 s, about 53 minutes. If an alteration narrows the width to 1.8 m, the time rises to about 71 minutes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期做避難演練並記錄實際通過時間，與設計值比較；空橋支承、伸縮裝置與防火門每年檢查，並在強風或地震後檢查位移指示，以及門扇是否變形卡住。~Hold regular evacuation drills, recording actual crossing times against the design values; inspect bridge bearings, expansion joints and fire doors annually, and after strong winds or earthquakes check movement indicators and whether door leaves have distorted and jammed.
units.failure: 若改裝縮減了淨寬或在可動接縫上加裝固定物，緊急時疏散時間延長，強風時接縫被卡住還會損壞空橋；防火門因塔體相對位移而變形卡住，會讓避難路徑在最需要時失效。~Alterations that narrow the width or fix items across movement joints lengthen evacuation time and, in strong winds, jam the joints and damage the bridge; fire doors distorted and jammed by relative tower movement can defeat the escape route exactly when it is needed.
units.misconception: 空橋是觀光設施，改裝不需要考慮避難與結構。~The skybridge is a visitor attraction, so alterations need not consider evacuation or structure.
units.practice: 交接文件把空橋列為生命安全與結構雙重管制的設施，附上淨寬、可動空間、支承規格與檢查表；任何改裝申請須同時經消防與結構審查，並更新避難計畫。~Handover documents designate the skybridge as a facility under both life-safety and structural control, with clear widths, movement gaps, bearing specifications and inspection checklists; every alteration request needs both fire and structural review and an updated evacuation plan.

example: 筏基連續澆置練習：某塔筏基約 13,200 m³，要求連續澆置不留冷縫。若配置 4 部泵車、每部名目 80 m³/h、效率 75%，實際供料 4×80×0.75 = 240 m³/h，約需 13,200/240 = 55 小時；以 8 m³ 的預拌車計，每小時約需 240/8 = 30 車。若筏基面積約 2,900 m²、分層厚 0.5 m，每層約 1,450 m³，需 1,450/240 ≈ 6.0 小時才能覆蓋整層；混凝土初凝時間若為 6 小時，已無餘裕。一部泵車故障使供料降為 180 m³/h 時，每層需約 8.1 小時、總時數增為約 73 小時，下層會在被覆蓋前初凝而形成冷縫，因此必須改用斜坡分層以縮小外露面積、加緩凝劑或預備備用泵。數值為教學假設，不代表雙子星塔的實際施工。~Continuous raft pour: a tower raft of about 13,200 m³ must be placed without cold joints. With 4 pumps of 80 m³/h nominal at 75% efficiency, actual supply is 4×80×0.75 = 240 m³/h, needing about 13,200/240 = 55 hours and, with 8 m³ trucks, about 240/8 = 30 trucks per hour. If the raft is about 2,900 m² and placed in 0.5 m layers, each layer is about 1,450 m³ and takes 1,450/240 ≈ 6.0 hours to cover; with an initial set of 6 hours there is no margin. If one pump breaks down and supply falls to 180 m³/h, each layer takes about 8.1 hours and the total about 73 hours, so the layer below sets before it is covered and forms a cold joint; the plan must therefore use sloped layering to shrink the exposed face, add retarder or keep a standby pump. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual Petronas operation.
history: 吉隆坡雙子星塔由國家石油公司 Petronas 委託、César Pelli 建築師事務所設計，Thornton Tomasetti 與 Ranhill Bersekutu 擔任結構工程師，塔一與塔二分別由間組與三星物產領銜的團隊施工；1992 年動工、1998 年完工、1999 年正式開幕，以 451.9 m 在 1998 至 2004 年間並列世界最高建築。1996 年高層建築與都市人居委員會依「尖塔計入、天線不計」的原則，認定其高度超越芝加哥西爾斯大樓，引發高度量測標準的討論。它以高強度混凝土管中管、雙鉸拱空橋與喀斯特地質上的深樁筏基著稱。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The Petronas Twin Towers were commissioned by the national oil company Petronas and designed by Cesar Pelli & Associates, with Thornton Tomasetti and Ranhill Bersekutu as structural engineers; Tower 1 and Tower 2 were built by teams led by Hazama and Samsung C&T respectively. Construction began in 1992, the towers were completed in 1998 and officially opened in 1999, and at 451.9 m they shared the title of world's tallest building from 1998 to 2004. In 1996 the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat, counting spires but not antennas, ruled that they exceeded Chicago's Sears Tower, prompting debate on height criteria. They are known for a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube, a two-hinged arch skybridge and deep piles and rafts on karstic ground. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 建築高度 451.9 m，地上 88 層、地下 5 層~Architectural height 451.9 m with 88 floors above ground and 5 below
1998 年完工，1998 至 2004 年並列世界最高建築~Completed in 1998 and jointly the world's tallest building from 1998 to 2004
核心筒約 23 m × 23 m，外圈為間距較大的超級柱~The core is about 23 m × 23 m, ringed by widely spaced super columns
空橋位於第 41 與 42 層，跨度約 58.4 m、離地約 170 m、重約 750 t~The skybridge at levels 41 and 42 spans about 58.4 m, about 170 m above ground, weighing about 750 t
空橋由約 51 m 長的雙鉸拱支腳支承於第 29 層~The skybridge rests on two-hinged arch legs about 51 m long seated at level 29
建築師資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 t~The architect records each tower as weighing about 300,000 t
每座塔以 104 支混凝土樁支承，深 60 至 114 m~Each tower stands on 104 concrete piles 60 to 114 m deep
筏基厚約 4.6 m、約 13,200 m³，連續澆置約 54 小時~The raft is about 4.6 m thick and 13,200 m³, poured continuously in about 54 hours
為避開石灰岩懸崖，塔位移動約 61 m~The towers were moved about 61 m to avoid a limestone cliff
塔一共有 39 部電梯，主要客梯為雙層電梯~Tower 1 has 39 elevators, its main passenger lifts being double-deck

timeline.event: 開挖約 30 m 深的基坑，深樁與筏基施工展開~Excavation of a pit about 30 m deep begins, followed by deep piles and rafts
上部結構開始施工，兩組承包商同時推進~The superstructure starts, with two contractors working in parallel
7 月以三天時間把預組的空橋吊裝就位~The preassembled skybridge is lifted into place over three days in July
尖塔完成，依尖塔計入的原則被認定為世界最高建築~The spires are completed and, with spires counted, the towers are recognised as the world's tallest
兩座塔完工，總高 451.9 m，並列世界最高建築~Both towers are completed at 451.9 m and share the title of world's tallest building

sources.title: CVU（原 CTBUH）摩天大樓中心：雙子星塔一號塔建築資料
sources.titleEn: Skyscraper Center (CVU, formerly CTBUH): Petronas Twin Tower 1
sources.publisher: Council on Vertical Urbanism (formerly Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat)
sources.scope: 高度、樓層、開工與完工年份、結構材料、設計與施工團隊、電梯與空橋的避難角色。
sources.scopeEn: Height, floors, start and completion years, structural material, design and construction team, elevators and the skybridge's evacuation role.

sources.title: Thornton Tomasetti：雙子星塔專案頁
sources.titleEn: Thornton Tomasetti: Petronas Twin Towers project page
sources.scope: 結構設計者說明空橋以一對鋼管支承於第 29 層的轉動支承，允許兩塔獨立移動。
sources.scopeEn: Structural designer's account of the skybridge carried by a pair of steel tubes on rotating bearings at level 29, letting the towers move independently.

sources.title: Pelli Clarke & Partners：雙子星塔專案頁
sources.titleEn: Pelli Clarke & Partners: Petronas Towers project page
sources.scope: 建築師說明八角星形平面、空橋功能、每座塔約 300,000 公噸重量與世界最高紀錄。
sources.scopeEn: Architect's account of the eight-pointed star plan, skybridge functions, the roughly 300,000 t weight per tower and the height record.

sources.title: 維基百科：雙子星塔（英文）
sources.scope: 核心尺寸、樁與筏基、塔位移動、空橋尺寸與吊裝時程、承包團隊的整理，作為延伸閱讀。
sources.scopeEn: Summary of core size, piles and rafts, the site shift, skybridge dimensions and lift date, and contractor teams, for further reading.

sources.title: 維基百科：雙子星塔（德文）
sources.scope: 施工循環、塔一垂直偏差修正與空橋支承等施工細節的整理；屬二手報導，數值以「約」表示。
sources.scopeEn: Summary of construction details such as the floor cycle, Tower 1 plumbness correction and skybridge bearings; secondary reporting, so values are given as approximate.
